## Problem and change
What user problem does this solve? Link related issues.

## Verification
List the OS/version, exact commands, results and any skipped tests.
For drag/drop changes verify originals are retained and only the actual dropped files are processed.
For workers verify cancel/timeout stops descendants and does not overwrite outputs.

## Security and compatibility
Declare new dependencies, network calls, permissions, global shortcuts and licence changes.
List limitations and backward-compatibility risks. Do not upload private test files.
